purpose: Teach: 月収/出来高/同上/組合せ/既定/特約/あっせん/引き渡し

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 社員の月収を業界平均と比較しましょう
lines.en: Let's compare our staff's monthly salary against the industry average.
lines.style: Efficient, matter-of-fact. Slight forward momentum on the opening. Professional but not rigid. A task stated clearly, expecting prompt acknowledgment.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。出来高給の社員制度を見直しました
lines.en: Yes. I've reviewed our performance-based compensation system for staff.
lines.style: Alert, ready. Light emphasis on the completed work. Steady eye contact level. Delivering the update with quiet competence—no flourish, just done.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 別表の数値は同上で省略しましょう
lines.en: Let's leave the figures in the appendix as-is to avoid repetition.
lines.style: Clear directive. Measured pace. Slight nod-emphasis on the decision itself. Practical, efficient—moving the meeting forward without debate.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。ご注文の組合せパターンを集計しました
lines.en: Yes. I've compiled a breakdown of order combination patterns.
lines.style: Steady report. Factual delivery. Slight pause before the detail—showing he's ready with specifics. Responsive, attentive to what was asked for.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 既定の手順を新人にも教えましょう
lines.en: We should teach the new hires the standard procedures too.
lines.style: Directive but collaborative in tone. Light emphasis on 'should.' Measured pace. Practical concern—making sure nothing falls through the cracks.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。お取引先との特約条項を一覧化しました
lines.en: Yes. I've created a full list of our special contractual terms with all partner companies.
lines.style: Detailed confirmation. Calm, methodical. Slight pride in the completeness—the work is solid. Steady delivery without rushing through the list.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 人材あっせん会社との契約を更新しましょう
lines.en: Let's renew our contract with the recruitment broker.
lines.style: Decisive proposal. Brisk but not rushed. Matter-of-fact opening. The kind of direction that expects action, not discussion.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。商品の引き渡し場所を再確認します
lines.en: Yes. I'll double-check the product handover locations.
lines.style: Final confirmation. Slight closing energy—wrapping up. Clear and committed. The 'I'll' lands with quiet assurance that this will be done before the next meeting.
